Male |affiliation =[[New California Republic]] |location =[[Shady Sands]] |role =City dwellers |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} The '''Shady Sands citizens''' are residents of [[Shady Sands]] and citizens of the [[New California Republic]] who appear {{in|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== Various denizens of the city of Shady Sands are seen in a flashback of the events leading up to the [[Nuclear weapons|nuclear destruction]] of the city at the hands of [[Hank MacLean]].{{FOTV|2|2}} ==Appearances== These Shady Sands citizens appear {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|10=202}} ==Behind the scenes== The Shady Sands citizens are portrayed by various uncredited background actors, including, but not limited to: * [[Shina Adeboye]] ==Gallery== FOTV S2E2 Shina Adeboye Shady Sands citizen.png|[[Shina Adeboye]] ==See also== * [[NCR trooper (TV series)]] ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Caesar's Legion characters]]
